poseOrigin: 10/1 batch jaw frame pose (copy-manifest object 14, community-4.stl), recovered by registering that print mesh to the source jaw (vertex-identical, residual 1e-8); the source frame is the same robot frame
changeReason: V1.8 jaw frame: the 10/1 jaw frame (source 4.obj / ID4) with the lower lip pad (source q.obj / ID42) printed as part of it instead of glued into its pocket, so no joint in the beak is glued and the whole beak is yellow. A 0.9 mm bridge inset 1.5 mm inside the pad outline ties the pad bottom to the pocket floor; geometry outside the pad box is identical to the 10/1 jaw (print/jaw-pad/merge_jaw_pad.json). The pad underside at the two back corners of the lip prints over low support 1.7 to 3 mm above the bed.

poseOrigin: V1.6 final face-panel pose (final-V1.6.json face_panel.sourceToPrint); the source frame is the same robot frame
changeReason: V1.8 face plate: flat 1.3 mm plate only. Four camera bearing lands, two locating pegs and two 2.2 mm screw holes for the direct camera mount; the inherited corner bosses, eye bosses, oval slot, clamp anchors and two blind pockets are removed or filled, and the three 0.58 mm pits the old clamp pilots left in the back face are filled flat (print/face-pits/fill_pits.json).

poseOrigin: V1.6/V1.7 cap flat pose expressed in the robot frame: worldToFlatPrint = sourceToPrint @ worldToStlFrame from candidates/head-cap-pi-shift/manifest.json (same 104.39 mm2 bed contact and bounds)
changeReason: V1.8 head cap: the V1.7 cap (Pi seat 4.6 mm back, +y rail trimmed) with both Pi rails raised 1.0 mm so the plugged jumper housings clear the lower shell without a beak window, and the two unused rear roof bosses removed. The four audio roof posts (two speaker-cage bosses, two amplifier posts) are removed too: the speaker and amplifier are deferred to a later loose add-on (cap-no-audio/remove_audio_posts.py). Outer skin identical to V1.6.

supportBlockers.reason: Keep the +y upper Pi pilot (E-pi-04) free of internal support; the V1.6 Bambu slice put 15 support segments in it. Moved with the rails (+1 mm z over V1.7). Non-printing slicer modifier, robot frame.
Keep the two zip-tie slots of the rear cable notch free of support in the flat pose (V1.6 pose-0 slice put 851 support samples there). Robot-frame copy of the V1.6 blocker; the notch is unchanged.

changeReason: V1.8 eye trim: as V1.6 plus two 1.7 mm pilots (x 81.3..87.0 at z 120.6 and 141.6) for the M2 x 8 camera screws.

poseOrigin: print/rear-pack/print-poses.json: upright as in the robot, floor (robot z -44) on the bed; 660.6 mm2 bed contact
changeReason: V1.8 rear electronics pack: hangs on the four existing hip-yaw case screws in place of the integrated power support and holds the OpenRB-150 upright on four pads, the DFR1202 in a channel behind it and the BNO085 on its front plate (no junction pocket: the servos take power through the OpenRB ports). Replaces the power support, the regulator insert, the OpenRB tray, the fuse bank and the IMU clamp/cover; no fuses.
